hero.title: Physiotherapy for Indian Students in Australia
hero.subtitle: The goals of the medical field of physiotherapy are to assist individuals recover from illnesses, injuries, and physical disabilities as well as to improve movement, manage pain, and restore physical function.

overview: Study Physiotherapy programs in Australia incorporate classroom instruction, the development of practical skills, and clinical internships under supervision. After finishing an appropriate bachelor's degree, Indian students can pursue postgraduate entry programs or undergraduate degrees following Class 12.

faq.question: After completing their 12th grade education, are Indian students able to pursue physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: Indeed. After Class 12, qualified students can apply to undergraduate physiotherapy programs, according to the academic, subject, and English language criteria of each university.

faq.question: In Australia, how long does physiotherapy take?
faq.answer: It typically takes four years to get an undergraduate degree in physiotherapy. The length of graduate-entry professional programs may vary.

faq.question: What is the price of studying physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: For undergraduate programs, tuition can often range from AUD 40,000 to AUD 65,000 or more each year. Living expenses are extra, and fees differ depending on the institution.

faq.question: Is taking the IELTS required for physiotherapy in Australia?
faq.answer: Students must fulfilll the recognized English language criteria of the university. High minimum scores are required for several physiotherapy programs, and there is an additional English language requirement for professional registration.

faq.question: Does admission to physiotherapy in Australia need NEET?
faq.answer: For Australian physiotherapy programs, NEET is not always a prerequisite for admission. Verify the specific program's and university's prerequisites.
